state.task: Repeated enrollment of one device consumes the retained-grant bound and eventually blocks a different device. Which reading most directly exposes the allocation/capacity decision?

source_context.public_task: Device re-enrollment in `crates/coder-access` keeps adding grants until the 128-grant bound prevents a new device from enrolling. Fix grant retention so a device that enrolls again has one live grant, and revoked or superseded grants do not prevent new enrollment. Preserve the bound for distinct live devices and preserve already-issued delegated access when its issuing device enrolls again. Delegation must still narrow authority and obey explicit revocation; re-enrollment must not revive authority that was revoked or removed. Preserve invitation retry behavior. Cover the public invitation and owner-approved enrollment paths with regression tests. Read the crate README and `nips/openagents/NIP-HOST.md`. Work only on the isolated code and tests in `crates/coder-access/`; host-store cleanup, deployment, owner devices, and changes outside this package are outside this trial.
